quarterly_data.signal: ASUS launched the XA P2N-E2, a 2U NVIDIA MGX-based server powered by NVIDIA Vera CPUs for agentic AI and reinforcement learning (the execution layer: code execution, tool use, sandboxing, data processing, orchestration), supporting up to two dual-slot NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs; unveiled at OCP Global Summit 2026 (no shipment date stated).
quarterly_data.figure: 2U Vera CPU server; up to two RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs
